sources.note: Avid HD I/O Guide v8.1 (opened, PDF text read and the two panel illustrations on p.5 and p.7 extracted locally): front panel = power button with LED ring, sample-rate and sync-mode LEDs, loop-master LED and 16x2 meters; back panel (8x8x8 configuration) = Bay 1 Analog In (two DB25: +4 dBu left, -10 dBV right), Bay 2 Analog Out (DB25), Bay 3 Digital I/O (AES/EBU DB25, TDIF DB25, ADAT optical, AES/EBU XLR in/out, S/PDIF RCA, WORD CLOCK and LOOP SYNC BNC in/out), Bay 4 empty, DigiLink EXPANSION and PRIMARY ports, ACCESSORY DB9, IEC inlet. The guide states no physical dimensions.  DEPTH 355.6 mm (14 in) is NOT sourced: searched again 2026-11-10, no Avid page or datasheet gives the chassis depth (retailers list only 2U and about 24 lb; an Avid forum thread (duc.avid.com, 2013) has users measuring about 13 in and about 14.75 in including the jacks), so 355.6 mm stays as a middle value, unconfirmed within about +/- 25 mm; the port y positions do not depend on it.

Rear panel illustration embedded in the same PDF (p.7, extracted locally, 863x168 px). Scale 1.775 px/mm from the rack-ear mounting slots (centres 823 px apart = 465.1 mm EIA spacing; vertical 136 px = 76.2 mm for the outer holes of a 2U). x from the left ear outer edge, y from the bottom edge; the picture is seen from behind, which is the outside of the io face. Expect +/- 4 mm.

Front panel illustration embedded in the same PDF (p.5, extracted locally, 867x243 px, front straight-on with the top surface visible). Scale 1.727 px/mm from the ear slots (131.6 px = 76.2 mm). power = round button with green LED ring; sample-rate = the 48 kHz LED of the SAMPLE RATE row (the real unit has no sample-rate control, the rate is set in Pro Tools and only shown on LEDs).

Wave 5 re-measure on the rear picture itself (rear.jpg crop 12,610,1476,272 over 482.6 x 88.9 mm, 3.06 px/mm, read on a mm grid): the first positions were taken from the manual illustration and sat 10 to 16 mm off the connectors of the photo. Shell centres incl. ears: ANALOG INPUT +4 dBu DB25 (43.0, 72.1), ANALOG OUTPUT DB25 (79.0, 28.1), AES/EBU DB25 (187.0, 62.1), DigiLink PRIMARY PORT (332.4, 9.8), WD CLK in BNC (434.1, 68.2), WD CLK out BNC (434.5, 45.1), AC inlet opening unchanged (448.2, 15.1). +/- 0.5 mm.
